brief.prompt:
INITIAL GENERATION PROMPT (verbatim)
Use case: illustration-story.
Create exactly ONE finished Japanese basketball news thumbnail, a wide landscape PNG, approximately 16:9, ideally 1600 x 900 pixels, width at least 1000. It is for バスケまとめ, article date 2026-11-26.
Editorial content is ONLY: 2026.11.26 has no scheduled games in B.PREMIER, B.ONE, or B.NEXT, according to the fixed article's material acquired 06:45 JST that morning. Do not add any score, opponent, player achievement, game result or claim of a game having taken place.
Visual style: the approved black and lime hand-ink basketball poster style shown earlier. Nearly black #151A18 background, lime #CCF43B broad diagonal dry-brush stroke behind the player, bold off-white Japanese headline, rough ink contours, expressive brush hatching, sparse splatter. Clearly a hand-drawn editorial illustration, not a photograph or photorealistic rendering. Restrained, clean, high-impact composition with only one player, one basketball and typography.

Subject: the real current B.LEAGUE player JAMES BELL / ジェームズ・ベル. He was randomly selected as a symbolic basketball image because this article names no players or teams. His OFFICIAL Yokohama B-Corsairs portrait was visually checked: https://b-corsairs.bl.kuroco-img.app/v=1791970457/files/user/team/2026-27/31_BELL.jpg . Translate his actual face into an original ink illustration: very short tightly curled black hair close to scalp, high rounded forehead, elongated oval face, dark almond-shaped eyes, moderately broad nose, full lips, connected moustache and dense black beard, with a distinctly longer rounded lower chin section. Tall strong athletic body with broad shoulders, not thin. Preserve these likeness traits. Do not substitute the short-bearded player from the approved style image.
Depict him alone on the LEFT 42% of the canvas in a dynamic, low, bent-knee driving pose in three-quarter view, face visible and looking forward toward the center. One orange basketball held naturally near his outer hip in one hand as he gathers a dribble; the other arm flexed forward for balance with a natural hand. One anatomically coherent player with two arms, two hands, two legs; keep face, hands and ball clearly inside the canvas and unobstructed. Cropping below knees is acceptable. Plain black/off-white sleeveless basketball jersey and shorts with NO number, lettering, logos, sponsors or recognizable emblems. Arms may have simplified ink tattoo textures without lettering. This is a generic illustrative movement, not a recreation of any actual game, specific shot or event. No opponent, crowd, scoreboard or hoop required.
Composition: illustration occupies the left, all main text occupies the RIGHT with clear separation. Enormous clean Japanese headline dominates the right center. Text entirely within comfortable safe margins, no clipping, no overlapping the face/hands/ball. Small footer sits on a calm solid dark band. Maintain rich brush texture on the drawing, but clean readable text.
Render ONLY the following exact visible text, with correct Japanese glyphs:
Top small branding: 「バスケまとめ」
Date prominently above headline: 「2026.11.26」
Largest headline, in bold lime or off-white: 「試合なし」
Below headline, one clean line in off-white, large enough to read: 「B.PREMIER・B.ONE・B.NEXT」
Smaller factual qualifier directly below: 「資料取得 06:45 JST」
Bottom footer, clearly legible: 「イラスト（AI生成）」 and 「イメージ」
The corner brackets are delimiters, not visible text. No other wording. Do not print the player's name, team name, number, stats, source URLs or scores anywhere. No team or league logo, no copied official photograph, no watermark. The two footer labels must remain present and fully readable.

ONE ALLOWED CORRECTION PROMPT (verbatim)
Edit this existing thumbnail once to fix ONLY the layout and crop problem. Preserve the same James Bell likeness, ink illustration style, black #151A18 and lime #CCF43B palette, identical illustration pose, one player and one orange basketball, plain unbranded uniform, and every existing text string without any change.
The player's hand holding the basketball is clipped at the LEFT canvas edge, and the headline is too close to the right edge. Recompose at the same 16:9 landscape aspect ratio by slightly reducing the illustration and moving it inward, and slightly reducing the text block as needed. Extend/reconstruct the left hand and arm naturally so the entire hand, all five fingers including thumb, the wrist, and basketball are clearly INSIDE the canvas with at least 60 pixels of empty margin. Keep head fully inside with 45 pixels above. Keep all right-side text at least 60 pixels from the right edge. Keep footer fully inside at least 35 pixels from the bottom. Cropping of the legs below knees is fine, but NO clipping of head, hands, ball or text. Maintain readable large lettering and the same overall left-player/right-headline composition. Player remains a recognizable hand-drawn James Bell with very short black hair, high forehead and long full black beard. No photos, logos, jersey numbers, extra people, extra limbs or added words.
Exact visible text must remain:
バスケまとめ
2026.11.26
試合なし
B.PREMIER・B.ONE・B.NEXT
資料取得 06:45 JST
イラスト（AI生成）
イメージ
Do not put the player's name or performance on the image. This remains a symbolic AI illustration, not an actual game scene. Return one complete PNG, approximately 16:9, width at least 1000 pixels.
